definitions: Small pieces of paper, especially for writing notes or making lists.
Undergarments worn under a dress or skirt.
Narrow strips of material, often used for decorative purposes or as part of a garment.
A sudden, uncontrolled movement, especially a fall.
examples: He wrote the number on a slip of paper.
She wore a silk slip under her dress.
A momentary slip in concentration cost him the game.
The dress had delicate lace slips.
Be careful not to take a slip on the wet floor.
